buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW)

Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK FOR AMC/CAMC OF LEICA GS 18 (DGPS) EOUIPTMENT FOR ONE (1) YEAR. The under mentioned DGPS purchased by this office on 06 Nov 2020 through GeM for survey of Defence land which is required to be kept in good working condition for its optimal utilization. The service provider is required to perform preventive maintenance / service /repairs/calibration during the contract period of AMC/CAMC. Sl No Qty Item Description Model Category Name (a) 2 LEICA Integrated Receiver Antenn GS18T LTE Receiver for Global a Receiver For Global Navigation S atellite System (Gnss) With Micro S Navigation Satellite System D and SDHC. (GNSS) (b) 1 LEICA Storage Controller for Globa Leica CS20 LTE Controller for Global l Navigation Satellite System. Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) (i) The Service Provider shall carry out preventive maintenance of the DGPS equipment at least twice every year by deputing a qualified, competent and experienced service engineer/technician to this office. In the event of any brea kdown or malfunction of the equipment, the Service Provider shall promptly attend to the complaint, carry out the n ecessary repair/service and restore the equipment to proper working condition. The equipment shall be returned to this office after completion of the required repair/rectification. (ii) In case of any error, malfunction or technical issue occurring in the DGPS equipment during survey/land measur ement, the Service Provider shall attend to and rectify the same promptly upon being reported by the SDOs/Survey ors of this office. (iii) The Service Provider shall be an OEM-authorised/empanelled service provider and shall furnish valid documentar y proof of such authorisation, wherever applicable. (iv) The AMC/CAMC shall be on a comprehensive basis, inclusive of all necessary repairs, servicing, labour charges a nd replacement of defective/failed spare parts/components, without any additional financial liability to this office du ring the currency of the contract. (v) Any defective spare parts/components requiring replacement shall be replaced with new and genuine OEM parts or parts specifically approved/recommended by the OEM as per the applicable service manual/specifications. No ref urbished, used or non-genuine parts shall be used without the prior written approval of this office. (vi) The normal working hours of this office shall be from 09:30 AM to 06:00 PM on working days. Saturdays and Sun days shall be treated as holidays, except where services are specifically required by this office on an urgent basis. (vii) The Service Provider shall promptly attend to any sudden breakdown or failure of the DGPS equipment upon rec eipt of intimation from this office. All costs towards transportation, conveyance, visit charges, labour, handling and o ther incidental expenses incurred for attending to and rectifying such breakdown shall be borne by the Service Provi der, and no separate payment on this account shall be made by this office.

(viii) Any delay in attending to or rectifying a reported fault beyond the stipulated time, without valid justification, s hall attract penal action. (ix) This office reserves the right to cancel/terminate the Work Order/AMC/CAMC, in whole or in part, in the event of unsatisfactory performance, failure to comply with the terms and conditions of the contract, or for any other reason s as may be permissible under the applicable Government rules and terms of the contract. 2. Payment: The payment will be done on quarterly basis whereby the service provider is required to forward I nvoi ce, Bank Mandate Form, Cancelled cheque in original, GeM Generated Invoice, service report, PAN details and GST Registration to enable this office to process the bill with Area Accounts Office, Jorhat, Assam/CDA Guwahati, Assam either online or offline as the case may be. The final payment will be released/credited in the account No of the firm by Area Accounts Office, Jorhat, Assam/CDA Guwahati, Assam.
